_notes: Direction (organism, reference, layer) = mean over the 256 exp/04 neutral prompts of the MO's residual at position cont_1 (the second token after the assistant tag, mobfr's position 1) minus the reference's, as a unit vector; the reference roles and the cross map come from exp/06 selfie_common.references_of.

Target norm n(organism, layer) = mean token norm of the MO over the single-token poolings of the exp/04 cache (last_prompt, cont_0..4): the toolkit's convention of a mean residual norm away from the first tokens. The steering vector alpha * n * d_hat is added to the output of decoder layer `layer` at every position (prompt and generated tokens), the toolkit's convention.

Strengths are a fixed grid shared by every cell (no per-cell coherence search, decision 2026-09-17). Local sweep 2026-09-17 (italian unmixed_fd, parent direction, 6 prompts x 2 samples, outputs/sweep): at layer 7 Italian food appears at 0.2-0.3 and 0.5 is incoherent; at layer 14 it appears at 0.1-0.2 and outputs degrade above; hence 0.1 / 0.2 / 0.3. mobfr's searched thresholds sit around 0.4-0.5 of its residual norm at layer 7.

Prompts: mobfr's steering_prompts_mobfr.txt (20 prompts, diffing-toolkit resources), 5 samples each, temperature 1, max 200 new tokens (mobfr: 512; capped for the investigator's context), HF sampling defaults otherwise.

The unsteered set is one per organism (reader `unsteered`, layer 0 = no steering) and is the floor: the MO's own outputs with no reference. Each steered row carries its paired unsteered sample so the investigator can see both conditions (mobfr's `both` framing).
